Introduction

DALsooobin is a soloist and a member of Dal Shabet under her own company DalSooobin Company and A2Z Entertainment. She debuted with the single ‘Flower’ on May 12, 2016. Subin is a member of Dal Shabet. She is best known for her height.

Subin’s contract with Happy Face Entertainment expired in December 2017. She has left Happy Face entertainment, however it is possible Dalshabet may participate in activities together in the future.
As of 2019 Subin is in a new one-man label called "DALSOOOBIN COMPANY" and has released her first single under the stage name DALsooobin, called "Katchup".

On July 28, 2023, she had signed an exclusive contract with A2Z Entertainment to resume activities as a DJ under the name DJ SUVIN.

On April 11, 2025, Subin has been identified as a member of the upcoming EDM girl group OSDS
